info.title: Channel dashboard — live API only
info.seed: +963900000001 — role channel_manager on demo-channel (id 1). OTP_BYPASS=true only under local|testing. Staging/production ignore the flag. Without bypass, random 6 digits (not all zeros — zeros are rep-* only).
info.not: This is NOT the platform admin (guard platform, port 3000) and NOT the warehouse / Flutter apps.
info.rule: If this file and the catalog disagree, this file wins. Call only live:true. Never call forbidden. Never mock missing retailer/warehouse/product-show lists. Gate screens with permissions[] from verify-otp, not role names.

headers.Authorization: Bearer {token} — required except GET /health, GET /public/refs, POST /channel/auth/*
headers.Accept-Language: ignored — SetAcceptLanguage forces locale en; map error.code in the UI
headers.X-Device-Id: stable UUID — rate-limit key on OTP request
headers.X-Idempotency-Key: UUID per user intent on every write except the two channel OTP paths
headers.X-Channel-Id: do not send — honoured only for platform_admin. Channel tenant comes from membership (defaultChannelId).

envelope.money: integer minor units everywhere except GET/POST /channel/zones delivery_fee and min_order_value (decimal strings, 2 places). SYP decimals = 0. Never /100.
envelope.sort: never send sort — lists use defaultSort; Spatie rejects unknown sorts
envelope.not_found: 404 means missing OR not yours — never render forbidden
envelope.permissions: Hide nav items with can(code) from verify-otp.permissions. Do not branch on role name (channel_manager / sales_manager / …).
envelope.dual_approval: adjust / credit-note / void may return {approval_request_id} with meta.requires_dual_approval. A second user resubmits the same body plus approval_request_id + approval_reason. Same user → 403 sod_violation.

forbidden.reason: No offer show / PUT. List + POST + PATCH stop + GET performance.
Channel IAM is not seeded. Users and roles are platform-only.
No logout route. Clear the token locally.
No me/session. verify-otp is the session.
Wrong guard. Never call retailer or rep routes from this dashboard.
Export returns job_id. No job-status poll route.

gotchas: No POST /channel/auth/logout. Discard the token locally. There is no GET /channel/me — the session is the verify-otp payload (token, channels[], permissions[]).
X-Channel-Id is ignored for channel users. channels[] from login is display-only — no tenant switch API on this guard.

OTP_BYPASS is honoured only when APP_ENV is local or testing. Staging and production ignore it. Without bypass, channel codes are random 6 digits, not 000000. X-Client channel-web does not get the rep all-zero shortcut.

GET /channel/products list rows are only id, sku, name_ar, status. GET /channel/products/{id} returns the full editor body (pricing may be null — use PUT /products/{id}/pricing). variants[].stock is available qty on the channel default warehouse (0 when none).
GET /channel/categories/tree nodes include media_id (editable) and activity_type_ids; image remains a resolved URL.
POST /channel/sub-orders/assign mode auto|bulk_zone is real: first on-duty rep covering the zone (or rep_id on bulk_zone). No candidate → 422.
Pricing lists stop-at-first-match (retailer ← group ← zone); they do not stack adjustments.
Retailer credit on_exceed=manual_approval queues GET/POST /channel/credit-approvals (EP-SC-165/165A); confirm returns 423 with approval_id until approved then consumed.
Banner impressions increment when GET /app/content/home-blocks serves a Banner row. Clicks via POST /app/content/banners/{id}/click. stats.ctr is integer basis points at scale 10^4.

GET /channel/offers list rows are only id, name, type, status. GET/PUT /channel/offers/{id} and activate exist. conversion_rate is scale 10^4 from unique retailer views; net_margin is linked_sales minus product cost_price.
GET /channel/invoices list rows are only id, no, total, status. GET /channel/invoices/{id} returns lines[] for credit-note line_id.
GET /channel/retailers lists shops in coverage zones (retailer_profile id). GET /channel/warehouses is the inventory picker.
No inventing retailer 360 approval, IAM, or fake media ids — use POST /channel/media/upload.
POST /channel/catalog/import is multipart: file + type=products + optional dry_run. JSON body is 422.
GET/POST /channel/zones delivery_fee and min_order_value are decimal strings ("12.50"), not int money. Unique exception on this guard.
DELETE /channel/zones/{id} is 204 empty body.
PUT /channel/content/intro returns {enabled} only — re-GET for the form.
Banner stats.ctr is integer basis points at scale 10^4 (840 clicks / 12000 impressions = 700), never a 0.07 float.

GET /channel/dashboard KPIs are 0 / empty until DailySnapshot has a row. Never fabricate GMV. meta.snapshot_date may be null. Run `php artisan reports:daily-snapshots` (scheduled 00:05 Asia/Damascus) for demos.

GET /channel/reports/{type} prefers a DailySnapshot whose snapshot_date is inside date_from/date_to; otherwise the latest. Unknown type still 200 with empty rows. Allowed types: sales|products|retailers|reps|zones|inventory|finance|offers|operations.
GET /channel/finance/aging: buckets are channel totals; groups[] splits by zone_id or rep_id when group_by is set.

POST /channel/inventory/adjust, credit-note and void may return approval_request_id instead of the mutation. Replay from a second user. channel_manager is exempt from SOD-01; still do not hide the payment button.
POST /channel/payments is SOD-01 vs sc.orders.confirm → 403 sod_violation unless the user is channel_manager.
Rep id everywhere (assign, settle, wallet, discount-cap, filter[rep_id]) is AppUser id from GET /channel/reps, not RepProfile id.
filter[waiting_over_minutes] on sub-orders is a custom query (not Spatie AllowedFilter) and still works as filter[waiting_over_minutes].

GET /public/refs (no auth) is the picker for activity_types, sale_units, root_categories, equipments. Shared GET /governorates|/zones|/currencies need a channel Bearer. Do not call /platform/refs/* (wrong_guard).
Category POST parent_id is required ≥1. Tree roots are platform root_categories (level 1); channel categories hang under them.

Unpaginated arrays (no page in meta): category tree, coverage zones, warehouses, sliders, loyalty rules, notification templates, dashboard, aging, report, margins, settings, intro, offer performance, banner stats, wallet.

endpoints.name: Health check
endpoints.description: Public liveness. No tenant, no auth.

endpoints.name: Shared list currencies
endpoints.note: Needs Bearer. decimals governs display; amounts stay int. is_base is never returned.

endpoints.name: Shared list governorates
endpoints.description: auth:platform,channel,warehouse,app. Prefer /platform/refs or /public/refs for new clients.
endpoints.note: Needs a channel (or any) Bearer. Paginated. search is top-level. filter[status] works. Do not call /platform/refs/governorates from this app (wrong_guard).

endpoints.name: Public reference snapshot
endpoints.description: Registration screens cache this locally and refresh by cursor (REQ-AD-032, REQ-CM-016).
endpoints.note: No auth. Use for activity_types, sale_units, root_categories, equipments pickers. Channels are never in this payload (REQ-IN-06). Merge by id; drop status!=active.

endpoints.name: Shared list zones
endpoints.note: Needs Bearer. Paginated. Shared read — not the channel coverage table (that is GET /channel/zones).

endpoints.name: Channel request OTP
endpoints.note: Body is {phone} only. X-Device-Id is the rate-limit key. Exempt from idempotency.

endpoints.name: Channel verify OTP
endpoints.description: Returns channel list when the user belongs to more than one.
endpoints.note: Body {otp_id, code as string}. No device_id. Unknown phone / no membership → 403 insufficient_permission. Stay on the login screen.

endpoints.name: Own channel settings
endpoints.description: The authenticated channel tenant reading itself. No X-Channel-Id.
endpoints.note: EP-SC-130A. SupplyChannelResource. allowed_next is for platform transitions — do not render those buttons here; this guard cannot POST /platform/channels/{id}/transition.

endpoints.name: Update own channel settings
endpoints.description: Partial update. status is not writable here — lifecycle stays on the platform. settings.quiet_hours {start,end,timezone} defers push/whatsapp delivery; settings.returns_sla_hours (int, default 24) sets return_requests.sla_due_at on create.
endpoints.note: EP-SC-130B. Partial. name/legal_name/tax_number/phone/email/settings. Cannot change status or slug.

endpoints.name: Channel dashboard
endpoints.note: Zeros / empty arrays until reporting writes DailySnapshot. meta.snapshot_date may be null. Never invent KPIs.

endpoints.name: Channel report
endpoints.description: type ∈ sales|products|retailers|reps|zones|inventory|finance|offers|operations
endpoints.note: Path type ∈ sales|products|retailers|reps|zones|inventory|finance|offers|operations. date_from/date_to select a DailySnapshot in range (else latest). Unknown type → empty rows 200.

endpoints.name: Brand detail
endpoints.description: Full editor body. logo/banner are media_id strings; logo_url/banner_url are resolved. Foreign or other-channel id → 404.

endpoints.name: Update brand
endpoints.description: Same body as create. status=disabled hides the brand and its products from retailer/rep APIs without deleting channel data. sliders[] replaces the full set.

endpoints.name: List brands
endpoints.description: Thin list. Filters: filter[status], filter[activity_type_id], filter[search] (name_ar|name_en). Default sort order.

endpoints.name: Create brand
endpoints.description: logo required (media_id from EP-SC-021); square image ≥512×512. description required ≤300. activity_type_ids required ≥1. name_ar unique per channel. status active|disabled. sliders.source ∈ algorithm|manual. banner optional media_id.

endpoints.name: Export catalog
endpoints.description: Async CSV with the same columns as import. Returns job_id only.

endpoints.name: Import catalog
endpoints.description: Columns: sku,name_ar,name_en,barcode,brand_id,category_id,status,base_price,currency_id. Multipart only.
endpoints.note: multipart/form-data: file, type=products, optional dry_run. Not JSON.

endpoints.name: Category tree
endpoints.description: Platform root categories (level 1) plus any channel-owned roots (parent_id null). description/media_id/activity_type_ids are null/[] on platform roots. image is a resolved URL; media_id is the editable id for PUT.

endpoints.name: Change category status
endpoints.description: Disable refused while the category (or any descendant) has active products or child categories — details.affected.{child_categories,active_products}. Soft disable only; no hard delete.

endpoints.name: Update category
endpoints.description: Does not move the node (use reorder) and does not change status (use PATCH …/status). image is a media_id string from EP-SC-021.

endpoints.name: Create category
endpoints.description: parent_id optional: omit or null to create a channel-owned root (level 1). Platform roots remain available as parents. 422 at the 6th level.

endpoints.name: Bulk product action
endpoints.description: action ∈ activate|disable|delete_draft|set_category|set_brand|set_zones|set_status. Cap 200. Price % stays EP-SC-033. payload.category_id / brand_id / zone_ids / status required per action.

endpoints.name: Duplicate product
endpoints.description: Clones product children (specs/media/units/zones/activities/groups/sliders/tags/inventory flags) and product pricing. Does not copy variants — regenerate via EP-SC-017. sku required and unique.

endpoints.name: Generate variants
endpoints.description: Cartesian regenerate. Existing variants matched by SKU keep barcode/image/price_override; unmatched SKUs are deleted.

endpoints.name: Delete variant
endpoints.description: Deletes one combination without regenerating axes.

endpoints.name: Update variant
endpoints.description: price_override null clears inheritance override. Non-empty barcode unique within channel. stock+warehouse_id sets absolute on_hand for that warehouse (omit both to leave inventory untouched).

endpoints.name: Product detail
endpoints.description: Full create/update body for the editor. pricing may be null when unset — use PUT /products/{id}/pricing. axes/variants from generate. Non-empty barcode must be unique within the channel (product or variant). Foreign or other-channel id → 404.
endpoints.note: Full editor body. pricing may be null until PUT /products/{id}/pricing.

endpoints.name: Update product
endpoints.note: Same FormRequest as POST (name_ar + sku required). media_id strings — no upload.

endpoints.name: List products
endpoints.note: List shape is thin: id, sku, name_ar, status. Filters: filter[brand_id|category_id|status|zone_id|search]. No GET show.

endpoints.name: Create product
endpoints.description: All money fields are integer minor units (BR-AD-18). 12000 ≠ 120.00.

endpoints.name: Create price list
endpoints.description: type: base|zone|group|retailer. Precedence stop-at-first-match (most specific wins; lists do not stack): retailer_price ← group_list ← zone_list ← qty_tier ← base_price.

endpoints.name: Activate offer
endpoints.description: From stopped or draft only. Expired → 409.

endpoints.name: Offer performance
endpoints.description: conversion_rate is integer at scale 10^4 (0.22 → 2200). null when no views recorded. net_margin null when cost is unknown — never a fake 0.
endpoints.note: conversion_rate is scale 10^4 (unique viewers). net_margin = linked_sales − cost_price×qty when cost is set.

endpoints.name: Offer detail
endpoints.description: Full create/update body for the editor. Foreign or other-channel id → 404.

endpoints.name: Update offer
endpoints.description: Same body as create minus status. Status changes only via stop/activate. Stopped/expired → 409 illegal_transition.

endpoints.name: Create offer
endpoints.description: type: product_discount|invoice_discount|buy_x_get_y|bundle|tiered_discount|gift. Deleting a line in the offer removes the whole offer (BR-08).

endpoints.name: Adjust inventory
endpoints.note: May return {approval_request_id} + meta.requires_dual_approval instead of movement_id. qty_delta is signed int.

endpoints.name: Inventory movements
endpoints.description: Immutable ledger with balance before/after.

endpoints.name: List transfers
endpoints.description: filter[warehouse_id] matches from or to. Paginated.

endpoints.name: Create transfer
endpoints.description: Statuses: sent then received.

endpoints.name: Assign to rep
endpoints.description: mode: manual|auto|bulk_zone. auto picks the first on-duty rep covering the sub-order zone; bulk_zone assigns every confirmed/postponed sub-order in zone_id (or the first id's zone) to rep_id or that on-duty rep. 422 if no on-duty rep covers the zone (BR-19).

endpoints.name: Bulk confirm
endpoints.description: Up to 50 ids. Target: 50 orders under 2 minutes.
endpoints.note: Max 50 ids. Partial success is 200 with confirmed[] and failed[].

endpoints.name: Cancel sub-order
endpoints.description: Releases reservation.

endpoints.name: Confirm sub-order
endpoints.description: Reserves stock, creates picking list, reveals channel name to retailer.

endpoints.name: Edit sub-order lines
endpoints.description: Mandatory retailer notification.

endpoints.name: Reassign sub-order
endpoints.description: Forbidden after handover is received.

endpoints.name: Reject sub-order
endpoints.description: Immediate retailer notification.

endpoints.name: Schedule sub-order
endpoints.description: Synced to the rep calendar.

endpoints.name: Sub-order detail
endpoints.note: Drive confirm/reject/edit buttons from allowed_actions, not from a hardcoded status map.

endpoints.name: List sub-orders
endpoints.description: Grouped by zone with warning colors in UI.

endpoints.name: Decide return request
endpoints.description: Financial and stock impact per BR-13. decision: approve|reject.

endpoints.name: Escalate overdue return SLA
endpoints.description: Only open+overdue return requests. Records audit and notifies channel managers via inbox/notification path.

endpoints.name: List return requests
endpoints.description: sla_due_at set on create from channel settings.returns_sla_hours (default 24). overdue when pending/approved and sla_due_at < now.

endpoints.name: Decide rep-sourced shop
endpoints.description: decision: approve|reject. Approve activates RetailerProfile and marks shop linked.

endpoints.name: Decide rep zone request
endpoints.description: decision: approve|reject. Approve attaches zone to RepProfileZone.

endpoints.name: Live map of on-duty reps
endpoints.description: On-duty reps for the tenant. lat/lng/at null when no ping. Single-rep live remains GET /channel/reps/{id}/live.

endpoints.name: Approve rep
endpoints.description: pending_review → active. reason optional. Illegal transition → 409.

endpoints.name: Disable rep
endpoints.description: active → disabled. reason required.

endpoints.name: Rep discount cap
endpoints.description: Exceeding cap at submit → 403 discount_cap_exceeded (BR-12).
endpoints.note: max_discount_percent 0–100 int. max_cash_hold int minor units, 0 = no cap.

endpoints.name: Rep live location
endpoints.description: Latest RepLocationPing for a rep on this channel. No ping → lat/lng/at null, on_duty still reported.

endpoints.name: Reject rep
endpoints.description: pending_review → rejected. reason required.

endpoints.name: Settle rep wallet
endpoints.description: Invariant: wallet.net_balance == SUM(collected) − SUM(settled) (AC-06).

endpoints.name: Rep wallet (channel read)
endpoints.description: Same ledger math as GET /app/rep/wallet. Foreign channel → 404.

endpoints.name: Show rep
endpoints.description: Foreign channel rep → 404.

endpoints.name: List reps
endpoints.description: id is AppUser id (same as assign / settle / discount-cap). status: pending_review|active|rejected|disabled.
endpoints.note: id is AppUser id. filter[status]=pending_review|active|rejected|disabled. Same id for assign / settle / discount-cap / wallet.

endpoints.name: Receivables aging
endpoints.description: group_by: zone|rep. buckets are channel totals; groups split by zone_id or rep_id.
endpoints.note: group_by=zone|rep is echoed; buckets are NOT grouped — global remaining on open invoices.

endpoints.name: Issue credit note
endpoints.note: Dual-approval eligible. lines[].line_id has no invoice-detail API — do not build a line picker from a missing show.

endpoints.name: Invoice detail
endpoints.description: lines[].id is the line_id for credit-note. Foreign id → 404.
endpoints.note: Includes lines[].id for credit-note. Foreign → 404.

endpoints.name: Record office payment
endpoints.description: SOD-01: must not be held together with sc.orders.confirm.
endpoints.note: SOD-01: 403 sod_violation if the same user also has sc.orders.confirm, unless channel_manager. method ∈ cash|bank|card. amount int.

endpoints.name: Retailer credit limit
endpoints.description: on_exceed: warn|block|manual_approval. block → 423 credit_limit_exceeded. manual_approval → queues EP-SC-165 then 423 with approval_id until approved+consumed. warn never blocks.

endpoints.name: Retailer 360 (rich)
endpoints.description: Same handler as EP-SC-140A; richer fields (outstanding, groups, assigned_rep_ids, last_order_at). Duplicate path for status tracking — OpenAPI operationId is EP-SC-164 (later code wins).

endpoints.name: List retailers in coverage
endpoints.description: Retailers whose zone is in this channel coverage. Id is retailer_profile id for credit/payments.
endpoints.note: Paginated shops in coverage zones. id is retailer_profile id for credit/payments.

endpoints.name: Zone coverage gaps
endpoints.description: Channel coverage zones with zero active reps, and zones with no default warehouse for the channel (all coverage zones when default warehouse is missing).

endpoints.name: Zone map with polygons
endpoints.description: Joins channel_zone coverage with reference zones.polygon. delivery_windows from channel_zone JSON.
endpoints.note: EP-SC-163. Coverage rows with zone.polygon and delivery_windows. Unpaginated.

endpoints.name: Remove coverage zone
endpoints.description: 204 empty body. Path param is the coverage row id (channel_zone.id), not zone_id.
endpoints.note: EP-SC-131C. 204 No Content. Foreign coverage id → 404.

endpoints.name: Channel coverage zones
endpoints.description: Unpaginated. delivery_fee and min_order_value are decimal strings (unique money exception on this guard).
endpoints.note: EP-SC-131A. Unpaginated coverage rows. delivery_fee and min_order_value are decimal strings. Path param on DELETE is the coverage row id (channel_zone), not zone_id.

endpoints.name: Upsert coverage zone
endpoints.description: updateOrCreate on zone_id within the tenant. Optional delivery_windows: array of {day ∈ sun…sat, start/end H:i}.
endpoints.note: EP-SC-131B. Upsert by zone_id. delivery_days ∈ sun…sat. Optional delivery_windows: {day, start H:i, end H:i}. Fees are decimal:0,2 not int money.

endpoints.name: Banner stats
endpoints.description: ctr is integer basis points at scale 10^4 (840/12000 = 700), never a float.
endpoints.note: ctr is integer basis points × 10^4. 0 when impressions=0. Catalog float 0.07 is wrong.

endpoints.name: Update intro screen
endpoints.note: Response is {enabled} only. Re-GET to refill the form. Empty store: enabled false.

endpoints.name: Create slider
endpoints.description: source: manual|brand|category|offers|algorithm. algorithm: new_arrivals|best_selling|most_ordered_by_retailer|suggested|similar|same_brand.

endpoints.name: Update reward
endpoints.description: Stopped rewards → 409.

endpoints.name: Decide credit approval
endpoints.description: decision: approve|reject. Only pending. Approve allows the next assertWithinLimit that fits the approved amount to consume the row.

endpoints.name: List credit approval queue
endpoints.description: Pending rows created when on_exceed=manual_approval and confirm would exceed. status: pending|approved|rejected|consumed.

endpoints.name: Weekly delivery calendar
endpoints.description: Derived from channel_zone.delivery_days. week= any date in the week (Asia/Damascus); week_start is Sunday. No new table.

endpoints.name: Job status
endpoints.description: type ∈ catalog_export|catalog_import|report_export|price_list_schedule. status ∈ queued|running|done|failed. progress 0–100. Channel-scoped; foreign job → 404.

endpoints.name: Upload media
endpoints.description: Multipart only. type ∈ image|video. Returns media_id + url for product/brand/category fields. Max image 8MB, video 50MB. Brand logos (used in EP-SC-010B/D) must be square ≥512×512 — validated on brand write.

endpoints.name: Delete retailer group
endpoints.description: 422 ref_in_use when a price list or offer still targets the group.

endpoints.name: Update retailer group
endpoints.description: Replaces name and membership atomically.

endpoints.name: List retailer groups
endpoints.description: Channel-owned groups for price lists (type=group) and offer targeting (scope=groups).

endpoints.name: Create retailer group
endpoints.description: retailer_ids must be retailer_profile ids in this channel coverage. Empty membership allowed.

endpoints.name: Invite channel user
endpoints.description: Creates/updates ChannelUser, membership, and a 72h ChannelManagerInvite. DOC-08 sc.iam.users_manage.

endpoints.name: List channel users
endpoints.description: Memberships for the current tenant. DOC-08 sc.iam.users_view.

endpoints.name: List channel warehouses
endpoints.description: Unpaginated picker for inventory adjust/transfer. No create on this path.
endpoints.note: Unpaginated picker. id for inventory adjust/transfer.
